|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/small/tatooinejundlandwastes.html</ref>

Since the Dawn Of Time (or at least the Premiere release), [[Tatooine: Jundland Wastes]] has been the best starting location for the Dark Side in sealed deck competition. Now each Light Side player gets a chance to bounce that evil site back to the Dark Side player's Reserve Deck.

The Light Side Jundland Wastes also gives a Force drain bonus when a [[Vaporator]] is played there. This provides a boost when combining with other cards often found in Premiere packs for sealed-deck competition.

In constructed-deck play, this site becomes an effective weapon to fight a ground-based, [[Tatooine]] Force drain strategy. The ability to convert the site and capitalize on its own Force drain bonus lets the Light Side grab the initiative.

Combos:

Jundland Wastes + [[Vaporator]] + [[Owen Lars]] + [[Beru Lars]] + Hydroponic Station: Let's total it up... for 5 Force and 5 cards, that's ability 4, power 4, forfeit 9 and a Force drain of 3 (and draw the first 2 Force activated directly into your hand). Not bad for a couple of middle-aged Rebels.

Jundland Wastes + [[Vaporator]] + [[Luke Skywalker]] + [[Anakin's Lightsaber]] + [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] + [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber]] + [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] + [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] + [[Jedi Lightsaber]]: A total ability of 12, power 14, forfeit 22 and a Force drain of 6! Talk about an [[Undercover]] spy magnet...
